artifact.analysis_basis: Read-only bytes from retained Xenia guest-memory backings; the exact XEX itself has no Ghidra load spec in the installed Ghidra 12.1.2.

memory_provenance.address_to_file_offset: Guest VA equals backing-file offset for these mapped code bytes; verified by matching the independent 68-byte exact-XEX capture at 0x82341198 in all 10 backings.

predicate.flag_clear_behavior: continues reading queue cursor/timing state and calls 0x823BA9C8; returns 1 on the timeout/progress path or 0 when the callback reports completion

runtime_crosscheck.notation_correction: The earlier runtime probe rendered the decimal GDB-script offset 10941 as 0x10941. The correct hexadecimal offset is 0x2ABD; the same GDB address and observed byte are unchanged.

interpretation.supported: The observed guest thread is executing the original XEX ring/cursor polling loop, not blocked inside a guest KeWait call. The exact wait helper repeatedly calls the retail predicate; the controlled no-plugin run has the expected unchanged cursor values and clear completion bit while all three Vd ring/interrupt setup calls are logged as ignored. This makes an unserviced Xenos ring/completion path the leading explanation for this wait, rather than a P-code or host scheduler failure.
interpretation.not_proven: A plugin-enabled controlled rerun is still required to demonstrate cursor/flag progress, return from the guest wait, reach a later retail runtime frontier, or produce a guest-originated Vulkan draw/present.
interpretation.next_owner: Process 2 owns Xenos GPU plugin setup; Process 1 should rerun the guest queue probe after that setup before changing guest wait semantics.
